pages.title: Pig Man Fat · Kobus Kennedy
pages.description: Pig Man Fat, or PMF: the true origin of a name that became a by-word, from an essay by DTW on a radio quiz producer and his shows. Tune a vintage set, and run the quizzes yourself.

pages.title: Pig Man Fat · Kobus Kennedy
pages.description: Volume IV, a special edition on Pig Man Fat: the true origin, as told in a supplied essay on a radio quiz producer, then an invented tall tale in the manner of Br'er Rabbit, retold twelve times, with the real traditions behind it and what could not be found.

pages.title: The Studio · Pig Man Fat
pages.description: Three small games built from an essay's description of Pigman Fat's radio quiz shows: Skip show 22, Find the Job and Venture. All questions and rules are the site's own.

pages.title: The Name · Kobus Kennedy
pages.description: Volume I. Ten chapters on twelve letters: origins, sound, anatomy, letters, figures, the monogram, company, weight, the K neither language handed Bodoni for free, the first name's long road from a heel, and what the name scores on a Scrabble board.

pages.title: The Broadcast · Kobus Kennedy
pages.description: Volume II. Forty seconds of SAfm radio, the callers who named the mystery song, the 1974 record Pick Up the Pieces, and the Miami session that made it.

pages.title: The Presenter · Kobus Kennedy
pages.description: Volume III. Rafe Lavine: thirty years of South African radio, his SAfm programmes, his ten records, the Peddlers he named among them, and what could be checked.

pages.title: Editions · Kobus Kennedy
pages.description: How this site grows: a log of every edition, and the open questions the next one might answer.
